items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: One guy, Sir Jerome (PHONETIC) from Chicago --

ctx.x: Well, in those days, let me tell you, it's like this. You might call them professionals. In those days there were lots of road shows. And it was -- although Herschel came from very near Austin, some little town that they say he didn't own when he died, somewhere like 28 miles from Austin. Now, he may not have been stranded, but there were many cases where musicians with some carnival or road show -- would hire them and get them out so far and drop them. Get up and leave in the middle of the night, and leave them…
I had several offers. One guy, Sir Jerome (PHONETIC) from Chicago --
But, I mean, you had become fairly proficient, obviously, on this B flat helicon, hadn't you?
